# Private security report template

Use these headings only inside
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/sierracatalina/context-layer/security/advisories/new).
This file is not a public issue template. Do not submit the completed report as an
issue, pull request, public discussion or commit. Never paste real secrets,
credentials, private conversations or affected personal data, even into a private
report; a synthetic reproduction is sufficient to begin triage.

If the private form is unavailable, wait for a private reporting channel to be
restored. No fallback email is advertised. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Affected revision and profile

Exact commit/version, artifact and runtime environment.

## Trust boundary and impact

Which invariant fails, who can trigger it, and the scope of plausible harm.
Separate demonstrated behavior from speculation.

## Synthetic reproduction

Minimal input, prerequisites, command, expected outcome and observed outcome.
Use generated data and test keys only, clearly labeled as synthetic.

## Test evidence and suggested mitigation

Which cases were run, what failed, and which environments remain untested.

## Disclosure coordination

Whether the issue is already public and any existing disclosure timing.
Provide only the contact information you choose to share privately. Draft-phase
triage is best effort; no response-time or remediation SLA is promised.
